role: A site reliability engineer at Cardinal Energy who is in the middle of an incident.
disposition: Rushed. Lowercase fragments, no greetings, no thanks.

sessions.goal: Find out which severity level your incident is and how quickly it must be acknowledged. Once you have that, ask one more thing: when the postmortem draft is due.
sessions.opening: ingestion is 40 min behind for all customers. what severity is that and how fast do i have to ack?

knowledge: There is a workaround for nothing; data is simply arriving 40 minutes late.
rubric: The agent says the incident is SEV2 and must be acknowledged within 15 minutes. Reference: in the On-Call and Incident Process a delay in data of more than 30 minutes is SEV2, acknowledged within 15 minutes.
When asked, the agent says the postmortem draft is due within 5 business days of resolution.
